objectives_fil: Gamit ang dummy equipment, sundin ang trainer-approved safety checklist at ipakita ang agarang reporting at referral response sa simulated needlestick.
objectives_en: Using dummy equipment, follow the trainer-approved safety checklist and demonstrate immediate reporting and referral for a simulated needlestick.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang needlestick injury ay iulat at ipasuri kaagad; hindi sapat ang paghuhugas lamang.
sections.takeaway_en: Report and obtain immediate evaluation after a needlestick; washing alone is insufficient.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang competency ay nakikita sa ligtas na demonstrasyon sa loob ng saklaw ng pagsasanay.
sections.takeaway_en: Competence is shown through a safe demonstration within the scope of training.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ang pag-uulat ng muntikang insidente ay pagkakataong maiwasan ang susunod na pinsala.
sections.takeaway_en: Reporting a near miss creates a chance to prevent the next injury.

sections.takeaway_fil: Hindi dapat maantala ng forms ang agarang reporting at medical evaluation.
sections.takeaway_en: Forms must not delay immediate reporting and medical evaluation.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ipakita ang ligtas na gawain; sa exposure, agarang tulong ang una at hindi hinihintay ang sintomas.
sections.takeaway_en: Demonstrate safe practice; after exposure, obtain help immediately without waiting for symptoms.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ipakita ang ligtas na gawain; sa exposure, agarang tulong ang una at hindi hinihintay ang sintomas.
sections.takeaway_en: Demonstrate safe practice; after exposure, obtain help immediately without waiting for symptoms.

check.prompt_fil: Natusok si Apple ng used needle ngunit walang sintomas. Ano ang gagawin?
check.prompt_en: Apple has a used-needle injury but no symptoms. What should she do?

options.fil: Hugasan, iulat agad at magpa-medical evaluation kaagad.
options.en: Wash, report immediately and obtain immediate medical evaluation.

options.fil: Hugasan at maghintay hanggang matapos ang visits.
options.en: Wash and wait until the visits are finished.

options.fil: Pumili ng gamot mula sa available supplies.

check.feedback_fil: Ang unang sagot ang tamang sequence. Hindi sapat ang paghuhugas lamang; maaaring maantala ng paghihintay ang time-critical na assessment at treatment. Qualified provider ang magpapasya sa paggamot. 1. Tama: hugasan, iulat agad at magpa-evaluation kaagad. Ang kwalipikadong provider ang magpapasya sa paggamot. 2. Hindi ligtas ang paghihintay hanggang matapos ang visits. Hindi sapat ang paghuhugas; kailangan agad ang reporting at evaluation. 3. Huwag pumili ng gamot mula sa supplies. Kwalipikadong medical provider ang magpapasya sa assessment at paggamot. Sa kathang-isip na simulation, ipinakita ni Apple sa trainer ang ligtas na dummy demonstration at agarang reporting at evaluation pathway. Kasunod ng pangangalaga ang documentation. Walang ipinapalagay na paggamot o medical outcome.
check.feedback_en: The first response follows the required sequence. Washing alone is insufficient; waiting can delay time-critical assessment and treatment. A qualified provider decides treatment. 1. Correct: wash, report immediately and obtain immediate evaluation. A qualified provider decides treatment. 2. Waiting until visits end is unsafe. Washing alone is insufficient; reporting and evaluation are needed immediately. 3. Do not choose medication from supplies. A qualified medical provider decides assessment and treatment. In the fictional simulation, Apple shows the trainer a safe dummy demonstration and immediate reporting and evaluation pathway. Documentation follows care. No treatment or medical outcome is assumed.
